newsitem.title: ESTONIA: AVERAGE LOAN INTEREST RATE FALLS IN JUNE.
newsitem.headline: AVERAGE LOAN INTEREST RATE FALLS IN JUNE.

text.p: The average kroon loan interest rate in Estonian commercial banks fell to 9.6 percent in June from 12.7 percent the previous month, the central bank said on Tuesday.
The average short-term kroon loan interest rate was 9.2 percent, down from 12.1 percent in May, it added in a statement.
The average long-term kroon loan interest rate was 11.5 percent compared to 13.3 percent in the previous month.
"The fall in kroon loan interest rates is a ruling trend," the spokesperson for the central bank told Reuters.
The average deposit interest rate fell to 3.8 percent in June from 4.5 percent the month before.
The average interest rate for loans given in foreign currencies fell to 9.3 percent from 9.9 percent, the central bank added.
